Method of Attack: Hijacking accessibility programs such as sethc.exe or utilman.exe by assigning debuggers via Image File Execution Options (IFEO) Registry keys to create backdoors accessible from the Windows lock screen
Using IFEO debugger values to launch malicious programs with escalated privileges when legitimate programs are started
Backdoor access via command prompt launched from Sticky Keys (sethc.exe) with System privileges
Impacted Systems: Windows systems with accessibility programs such as sethc.exe, utilman.exe, DisplaySwitch.exe, osk.exe, Magnify.exe, Narrator.exe, and Taskmgr.exe
Attack Vector: Modification of Windows Registry Image File Execution Options keys to assign debuggers to accessibility programs
Exploitation of accessibility features accessible from the Windows lock screen
Indicators of Compromise: Registry keys under HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Image File Execution Options\sethc.exe with debugger value set to c:\windows\system32\cmd.exe
Debugger values such as c:\windows\system32\cmd.exe, c:\windows\system32\taskmgr.exe, or c:\windows\cmd.exe assigned to accessibility programs
